checked_claims.note: Independently recomputed. y^3=x(x-1) is a mu_3-Kummer cover of P^1_x; v_0(x(x-1))=1, v_1=1, v_inf=-2, none divisible by 3, so g:Cbar->P^1 is totally ramified over exactly 0,1,infinity. Riemann-Hurwitz 2g(Cbar)-2 = 3(-2)+3*2 = 0 gives genus one, and y^3-x(x-1) is irreducible so Cbar is connected. Deleting the three ramification points gives C->B=M_{0,4} finite etale of degree three. For the resulting smooth affine curve, H^0(Cbar)->H^0(3 points)->H_c^1(C)->H^1(Cbar)->0 gives W_0 H_c^1(C)=Q^2 and Gr^W_1 H_c^1(C)=H^1(Cbar), with h^{1,0}=h^{0,1}=1; H_c^2(C)=H^0(C)^vee(-1)=Q(-1). Verified in detail. (i) Mtilde is the preimage in C^15 of the open M_{0,18} subset of B^15, hence a nonempty open subvariety of the irreducible variety C^15, so the asserted irreducibility (stated without proof in the artifact) is in fact immediate and is not a gap. (ii) Y = C^15 minus Mtilde is the preimage of the pairwise diagonals under a finite map, so dim Y <= 14. (iii) H_c^0(C)=0, so in compact-support Kunneth every one of the fifteen factors contributes degree 1 or 2; total degree 16 forces exactly one H_c^2 and fourteen H_c^1, and Gr^W_16 H_c^16(C^15;Q) is exactly the direct sum over the fifteen choices of Q(-1) tensor H^1(Cbar)^{tensor 14}. Weight 2+14*1=16 and degree 2+14=16 agree, so the class sits at the weight-equals-degree corner; the Hodge type (1,1)+14*(1,0)=(15,1) satisfies p+q=16 and p=15<=dim C^15=15, so no dimension inconsistency. (iv) F^15 H_c^16(T;C)=0 for dim T<=14 is the standard bound h^{p,q}(H_c^k(T))=0 for p>dim T (Peters-Steenbrink Thm 5.39); the artifact's hyperresolution/log-de-Rham justification is terse but the statement is correct. (v) Survival: Gr^W_16 is exact on the localization LES because morphisms of MHS are strict for W (this is exactly FND-0165), Gr^W_16 H_c^15(Y)=0 since weights of H_c^15(Y) are <=15, and the (15,1)-component functor is exact on pure weight-16 Hodge structures, so alpha, dying in the type-(15,1) part of Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Y) which is zero, lifts to a nonzero type-(15,1) class in Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Mtilde;Q). I attacked the loose phrase 'strictness gives type (15,1)' (strictness for F alone would give only F^15 nonzero, i.e. type (15,1) or (16,0)); the stronger claim is nonetheless correct via exactness on pure weight-16 Hodge structures, and either way the class is non-Tate.

Checked joint by joint. Riemann-Hurwitz for a degree-4 simply-branched genus-6 cover of P^1 gives r=18 branch points, matching M_{0,18} of dimension 15. A transitive subgroup of S_4 generated by transpositions is S_4, whose centralizer in S_4 is trivial, so objects of Hord^sb have no target-preserving automorphisms; an automorphism must also fix 18 ordered points of P^1, hence act trivially on P^1, so inertia is trivial and Hord^sb is a scheme, finite etale over M_{0,18} by the classical Hurwitz local-deformation/Riemann-existence theorem (corroborated in the packet by FND-0159, 'the classical Hurwitz space of a fixed ramification profile is etale over the configuration space of r points'). Because M_{0,18} carries three rigidifying sections the universal genus-0 curve is P^1 x M_{0,18}, so the family over any chart has a trivial (fixed) P^1 target, which is what the (CE) setup needs. Existence of a component X with Xbal nonempty follows from a balanced simply-branched cover, supplied by CLM-0112-4 together with nonemptiness and purity of dimension 15 of Hbar^bal (see the dependency checks). Mtilde is connected, so a connected component Xtilde of the base change is finite etale surjective of positive degree d over Mtilde; f^* on H_c exists because f is finite hence proper, the transfer f_! is defined for finite etale f, both are MHS morphisms, Q-coefficients make f_! f^* = d invertible, and f^* preserves Hodge type on Gr^W_16. The second localization is legitimate because Xtilde is smooth (etale over M_{0,18}) and connected hence irreducible of dimension 15, so T=Xtilde minus V is a proper closed subset of dimension <= 14 and F^15 H_c^16(T;C)=0 again applies. Transport of the nonzero type-(15,1) class to Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V;Q) is established.

Two halves, both check. Non-Tateness: a finite direct sum of Q(-8) is pure of type (8,8), and Gr^{15,1} Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V;C) is nonzero by CLM-0118-3, so Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V;Q) is not such a sum. Allowed-atlas status: V -> Hbar^bal is a composite of etale morphisms (V open in Xtilde; Xtilde -> X finite etale; X restricted to the balanced locus -> Hbar^{bal,sb} the branch-ordering torsor, which is representable finite etale because the branch divisor is etale over the base exactly on the simply-branched locus; Hbar^{bal,sb} open in Hbar^bal). V is a separated finite-type smooth, hence reduced and locally Noetherian, C-scheme, so for any separated finite-type etale atlas U of Hbar^bal the disjoint union U + V is again such an atlas and V is a connected component of it. I pressed on the objection that V alone is not an atlas: it is answered by additivity of H_c over disjoint unions, Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U+V) = Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U) direct-sum Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V), so the non-Tate class persists in the atlas. I also checked that V carries the setup FND-0167 requires: the family is the pullback of the balanced (CE)+(N) universal family, h^0(L)=3 on every geometric fibre by FND-0139/FND-0142, L is base-point-free by FND-0130/FND-0134, and V is reduced so Grauert gives base change for pi_*L.

This is the scope/logic claim and the place I attacked hardest; see strongest_attack for the full argument. FND-0167 defines (H-S) as 'Gr^W_{2j}H_c^{2j}(S;Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-j) for j=6,7,8' with S a universally quantified reduced separated finite-type C-scheme carrying the balanced setup, and explicitly disclaims asserting its truth. The task theorem_statement says the proof obligation 'includes ... the constant-coefficient corners of the balanced base and universal curve needed under FND-0165 and FND-0167', over 'a reduced locally Noetherian scheme atlas of the balanced tetragonal stack'. The j=8 instance of that conjunct is exactly 'Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q) is a direct sum of Q(-8)', which CLM-0118-4 falsifies for the allowed atlas S = U + V. The base and universal curve are not parts of Z, so the clause listing them cannot be read as further assertions about Z; it can only be an additional conjunct. A universally quantified conjunct falsified on one allowed instance falsifies the conjunction. The claim stands.

finding_candidates.statement: Reusable mechanism, independent of the tetragonal setting. Let W be a smooth connected complex d-fold admitting a dominant (in particular finite etale) morphism to M_{0,d+3}, equivalently to the complement of the diagonals in (M_{0,4})^d. Then W admits a connected finite etale cover W' with F^{d} Gr^W_{d+1} H_c^{d+1}(W';C) nonzero, hence with a non-Tate weight-equals-degree corner: pull back the mu_3-Kummer elliptic cover C -> M_{0,4} (from y^3=x(x-1), Cbar of genus one) in each of the d coordinates, take Q(-1) from one H_c^2(C) and H^{1,0}(Cbar) from the other d-1 factors, and note that every locus removed along the way has dimension <= d-1 so that F^{d} H_c^{d+1} vanishes on it and the class survives by FND-0165. Therefore no weight-equals-degree corner statement about such a base can be an etale-local statement, and no such statement can be proved by any argument that is invariant under finite etale refinement (transfer, averaging, monodromy-orbit counting, or descent along an atlas).

strongest_attack:
Verdict semantics first, to avoid ambiguity: ATT-0118 has result_type 'disproof', and 'confirmed' here means I confirm that ATT-0118 establishes what it claims, i.e. that the exact theorem_statement quoted above is FALSE as written. I do not certify the Tate conclusion; I certify its refutation.

Strongest attack attempted (scope and quantification, not mathematics). The counterexample never touches Z; it refutes only the subordinate conjunct about the balanced base. So I tried three readings that would save the theorem. (1) 'This includes ... the constant-coefficient corners of the balanced base and universal curve needed under FND-0165 and FND-0167' is a proof-route enumeration ('your proof must pass through these corners'), not an asserted conjunct. This fails: the sibling items in the same list ('the simply-branched and complementary non-simply-branched loci, every S_6-isotypic component') are assertions of content about Z, and the balanced base and universal curve are not parts of Z, so the third item cannot be a further assertion about Z and can only be an additional assertion. (2) 'a reduced locally Noetherian scheme atlas' is existential, so the campaign may choose an atlas avoiding V. This fails on standard lemma grammar ('Let S be ... Then ...' is universal), on the parallel with FND-0167, which introduces S universally as 'a reduced separated finite-type C-scheme carrying the balanced setup', and on the fact that no atlas is ever named: ATT-0112 and FND-0162 supply the stack Hbar^bal, not a distinguished atlas, so an existential reading leaves the theorem's own subject undefined. (3) 'as in the dual-confirmed ATT-0112' pins a specific atlas from ATT-0112. This fails because the phrase modifies 'the balanced tetragonal stack', not 'atlas' - ATT-0112's confirmed content is the stack (smooth, pure dimension 15, per FND-0162), and it contains no distinguished scheme atlas to pin. A fourth, weaker attack - V is only a component, not an atlas - is answered inside the artifact by additivity of H_c over U + V.

Second-strongest attack (Hodge bookkeeping), also unsuccessful. I re-derived every degree, weight and twist independently. Compact-support Kunneth on C^15 with H_c^0(C)=0 forces exactly one H_c^2 and fourteen H_c^1, giving degree 2+14=16 and weight 2+14=16, so the class sits precisely at the weight-equals-degree corner where FND-0165 applies; type (1,1)+14(1,0)=(15,1) has p+q=16 and p=15=dim C^15, so there is no dimension or twist inconsistency. Both removed loci (Y and T) have dimension <= 14, so F^15 H_c^16 vanishes on them by the standard bound h^{p,q}(H_c^k(T))=0 for p>dim T, and the class survives both localizations; on pure weight-16 Hodge structures the (15,1)-component functor is exact, so 'type (15,1)' is correct and not merely 'F^15 nonzero'. The finite-etale transfer needs Q-coefficients (d invertible) and the artifact uses only Q throughout, so the integral-coefficient attack does not bite. The stack-versus-scheme attack does not bite either: everything stays on schemes, which is exactly the regime FND-0165 permits and the regime the theorem itself selected by demanding a scheme atlas. No Gysin, no Poincare duality, no spectral sequence, no S_6 invariants/coinvariants, no semisimplification, and no predicted motive is used, so those attack vectors have no purchase. The disproof also correctly refrains from touching FND-0168, K, or any embedding into M_{6,6}.

Sharpest residual soft spot, recorded even under confirmation: the whole construction needs one balanced SIMPLY-BRANCHED cover to exist, and the packet's own self-contained witness for nonemptiness of H^bal (FND-0154) is a cover composed through an elliptic curve, which FND-0158 states is never simply branched. So the existence step rests entirely on CLM-0112-4 (non-simply-branched locus of dimension <= 14 in the pure-dimension-15 Hbar^bal), with FND-0163's Bujokas-Patel genericity remark as an independent but parenthetical backup. That dependency is dual-confirmed and the statement is standard, so I confirm it, but it is the one hinge on which the refutation turns and any repair attempt should not treat it as free.

What the disproof does NOT show, stated so it is not over-read: Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q) is untouched. FND-0167's corner map runs Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U) INTO Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S) direct-sum Gr^W_14 H_c^14(S)(-1) direct-sum Gr^W_12 H_c^12(S)(-2), i.e. the wrong way to propagate non-Tateness from the base to Z, and the dimension trick does not transport either: A=P_S(pi_*L) has dimension 17 and the non-reduced-divisor locus Delta has dimension 16 >= 15, so F^15 H_c^16(Delta) need not vanish and the localization argument stalls.

theorem_statement: Over C with Q-coefficients, on the balanced Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation-failure model Z=Ord(U) of a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) genus-six degree-four family on a reduced locally Noetherian scheme atlas of the balanced tetragonal stack as in the dual-confirmed ATT-0112, prove that the exact target graded piece of the H_alpha-object of Z is Tate of type Q(8) in Borel-Moore degree 16 (equivalently Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) is a direct sum of Q(-8)). This includes the simply-branched and complementary non-simply-branched loci, every S_6-isotypic component, and the constant-coefficient corners of the balanced base and universal curve needed under FND-0165 and FND-0167. Do not identify this with the global kernel K=ker(H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q)->H^{16}(D;Q)) (FND-0168). Do not construct a closed embedding, Gysin map, image, or support-exhaustion statement in M_{6,6}. This lemma does not resolve the campaign Hodge/Tate group RED-0001.
